description: Replaces occurrences of text in a Google Document, either across the document or in selected tabs. Supports case-sensitive matching and regular expressions.

tab_ids.title: Tab Ids
tab_ids.description: Optional. A list of specific tab IDs to perform the replacement on. If not provided, replacement occurs on all tabs.
tab_ids.human_parameter_description: List any specific tab IDs where you want to apply the text replacement.

find_text.title: Find Text
find_text.description: The text to search for in the document. Cannot be empty.
find_text.human_parameter_description: Provide the text you want to find in the document.

match_case.title: Match Case
match_case.description: Indicates whether the search should be case sensitive. Defaults to False (case insensitive).
match_case.human_parameter_description: Decide if the search should respect upper and lower case letters.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The ID of the document to update.
document_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the document to update.

replace_text.title: Replace Text
replace_text.description: The text that will replace the matched text.
replace_text.human_parameter_description: Enter the text you want to use as the replacement.

search_by_regex.title: Search By Regex
search_by_regex.description: Optional. If True, the find_text is treated as a regular expression. Defaults to False.
search_by_regex.human_parameter_description: Select this if you want to find text patterns using regular expressions.

WriteControl.title: WriteControl

targetRevisionId.title: Target Revision Id
targetRevisionId.description: The target revision ID of the document the write request is applied to. If the document was modified since the API read request, the write request changes are applied against the collaborator changes, merging both into a new revision.

requiredRevisionId.title: Required Revision Id
requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the document the write request is applied to. If the document was modified since the API read request, the write request is not processed and returns an error.

WriteControl.description:
Provides control over how write requests are executed. Contains revision ID information.
Uses a union field pattern - only one of requiredRevisionId or targetRevisionId should be set.

ResponseObject.title: ResponseObject
ResponseObject.description:
A single response from an update. Uses a union field pattern where only one response type can be present.
Replies to some requests may be empty.

footer_id.title: Footer Id
footer_id.description: The ID of the created footer.

header_id.title: Header Id
header_id.description: The ID of the created header.

footnote_id.title: Footnote Id
footnote_id.description: The ID of the created footnote.

occurrences_changed.title: Occurrences Changed
occurrences_changed.description: The number of occurrences changed by replacing all text. Returns 0 when no matches are found.

named_range_id.title: Named Range Id
named_range_id.description: The ID of the created named range.

ReplaceAllTextResponse.title: ReplaceAllTextResponse

replies.title: Replies
replies.description: The reply of the updates. This maps 1:1 with the updates, although replies to some requests may be empty.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: The display URL for the document where text was replaced.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The ID of the document to which the updates were applied to.

document_url.title: Document Url
document_url.description: The URL of the document where text was replaced.

write_control.title: Write Control
write_control.description: The updated write control after applying the request.

ReplaceAllTextResponse.description: Response from the Google Docs API batchUpdate method when executing a replaceAllText request.

object_id.title: Object Id
object_id.description: The ID of the created InlineObject.

object_id.title: Object Id
object_id.description: The object ID of the inserted chart.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
